I told Hollis in #central-team that the documented seat count for Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is 40.

- **Where 40 comes from:** the Affiliate Amendment set Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats from 2025-10-15. The 2026 Marrow renewal, signed 2026-04-22 and running through 2027-04-30, covered Fieldworks and kept Agrisupply's seats as the amendment set them. The account page also says 40.
- **Unconfirmed number:** on Oct 14 Tobias posted 382 seats in the same channel. When I asked him for a source, he didn't reply, so nothing backs that number up yet.
- **What I suggested:** use 40 on the account sheet and check with Tobias before changing it.

I only shared seat counts and dates, which anyone on the account's team can see, and left out pricing.
